utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I can help sort the donations and hand them out for the repair drive. Just let me know when and where.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’m at the sign-up table until 6, taking names and noting where folks are coming from. I’ll let you know the time and spot, and Quinn’s helping spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out for your update. If you need anything before then, just wave me over.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Sam — I’ll keep inviting more neighbors to the repair drive. Gus is already taking a couple spots and bringing some tools, so we’re in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, thanks Quinn. I’ll be there to sort things and keep an eye out for any tools that still need labels.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve sorted the tools and made a quick sign-up list for the repair drive. Uli’s keeping things low-key for now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — I haven’t heard any changes, so the repair drive still sounds on. I’ll send the sign-up sheet over to Faye so she can share it with a few parents and help steer folks to late-afternoon slots.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — thanks, Tess. Late-afternoon slots should work best, and I’ll keep things low-key with Uli.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, but I’m asking around for any repair drive updates. If you hear anything new, let me know — I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — I’ll wait for Rey to bring the details, and then I’ll help sort out the date and what’s needed. I’m happy to have you on hauling or sorting, too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I can bring a small item if that helps. I’ll wait to hear from Oren about what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm, the repair drive is still on and nothing’s changed? I’m checking what we still have on hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: As far as I’ve heard, yes — it’s still on and I haven’t heard any changes. I’m still waiting on Oren to tell me what small thing would help most.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check the final date and time for the repair drive and send it over once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — once you have the final date and time, send me the drop-off spot too and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll send the final date, time, and drop-off spot as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got a couple spots at the repair drive, and I’ll bring the tools too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — what’s the exact start time? I can still bring the gloves and box cutter.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It starts at 10 a.m. Thanks — gloves and the box cutter will be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m heading over to the sign-up table by the community hall entrance now. If you’re still around, Opal, I’d appreciate the walk over.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Faye — I’m on my way over now. If you hear the final date and time from Jules, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks—once Eli sends the timing and drop-off spots, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, just send me the timing and drop-off spots when Eli has them, and I’ll work around that.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Bo — I’ll do my best to help sort out what’s needed for the repair drive. Rey said they’d bring me the details, so I’ll keep an eye out for those.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the exact time too. I can bring gloves and a box cutter.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — that’d be a big help. Once Rey drops off the details, I’ll sort through what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal. I’ll bring the repair drive details once I have them, and I’ll let you know if anyone needs directions.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—just send me the details when you’ve got them, and I’ll note names and where folks are coming from. If anyone needs a walk over, I’m here until 6.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line people up around school pickup and steer volunteers into the late-afternoon slots. Once Jules sends the final date and time, I’ll help keep us from overlapping with the busiest pickup window.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s awesome, Faye — I’ll keep spreading the word so more neighbors know about the repair drive. Once Jules sends the final date and time, I can nudge folks into the right spots and let Opal know who’s coming from where.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll keep an eye on the school pickup window and help slot people into those later jobs once Jules sends the final details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can help sort the donations and hand them out for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That would be a huge help, Noah — thank you. I’ll let the team know you’re on sorting and handing out the donations.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — just point me to where the donations are, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, but I’m asking around for any updates on the repair drive. If I hear anything useful, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m heading to the sign-up table by the community hall entrance now. Opal said they’re taking names until 6, and she can walk me over if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, that helps — I’ll keep asking around and pass along anything else I hear.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll sort the donations by size and bring a box cutter, packing tape, and markers. Mara’s handling the donated tools and checking which ones still need labels.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll keep the supply list updated as requests come in. Rosa’s collecting them, and Kira can confirm what’s still available.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll stick to sorting by size and bring the box cutter, packing tape, and markers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on, and nothing’s changed yet? What do we still have left for it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on and I haven’t heard any changes yet. I’m getting the simple sign-up sheet together, and Faye said she can help steer folks to late-afternoon slots so we don’t run into pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm, we still have the drive on and you’re handling the sign-up sheet? What supplies do we still have left?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — Cleo’s helping me with the repair drive, and she’ll keep track of the supplies as they come in. I’ll keep Bo updated with the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’m bringing my tools and I’ve got a couple spots covered too. Just let me know if you need anything else for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Gus — thank you. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up, and I’ll keep Bo posted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help with hauling or sorting—has Uli set a date or time for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet, but I’m checking the final date and time and will send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — thanks. Let me know as soon as Uli confirms it, and I’m happy to help with hauling or sorting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Hana — I’ll wait for Oren to let me know what small thing would help most. If it comes up, I can bring something little for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good — I’ll wait for Oren’s cue too, and Sam can help sort the donations by size when he gets there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, that works for me too — I’ll keep an ear out for Oren’s update and bring a small item if he needs one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll send you the timing and drop-off spots first, then you can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, send me the timing and drop-off spots first, and I’ll plan around them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll write up the timing and the drop-off spots and send them over next.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll sort the donated tools and check which ones still need labels for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara. I’m keeping it low-key for now, but I can help a little and I’ll let Mina and Leo know when I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Uli. I’ll get the tools sorted and flagged for labels, and you can pass along the timing when you know it.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
